# Performance

The target is a docc check on 1000 documents in under one second. It is measured with a generated project of 1000 files with 5 to 20 KB of Russian text each (about 7 MB), with links, a parent tree and a kind schema.

On Linux (Intel Core i7-1165G7) the whole check takes about 0.31 seconds: loading 30 ms, rules 245 ms, rendering 22 ms and comparing the output folder 10 ms.

The measurement is repeatable with DOCC_SCALE set to 1 and the command go test ./cmd/docc -run Scale -v. Windows with a virus scanner and macOS have not been measured.

## History

The first measurement was 1.66 seconds. The word lists were matched with case-insensitive regular expressions, which took most of the time; a lower-cased search with word boundary checks brought it to the current value.
